results.title: AI-Readable Documentation Platform | DocsAlot
results.content:
### Install once. Ask in plain English.

Follow onboarding when you want the product to guide setup. Or run these commands, install the DocsAlot skill, and ask Codex, Cursor, Claude, or another repo-aware agent to create the first docs for your setup.

Follow onboarding ->Read CLI docs

agentic-setup.sh

copy/paste

$ npm install -g docsalot-cli

$ docsalot --version

$ docsalot skills install

agent > use docsalot cli to create docs for my project

Prompt to paste

"use docsalot cli to create docs for my project"

Features

## Built for polished docs and AI-visible answers.

DocsAlot is not just a docs host. It creates human-ready documentation, packages it for agents, and gives teams a visible benchmark surface for AI onboarding quality.

i

### Good-looking docs. Technically credible. [...] Read docs →Request audit

llms.txt is an emerging standard: a compact, structured table of contents at your site root that gives LLMs a canonical map of your docs. When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, or a coding agent about your product, it helps them route to your real pages instead of guessing from stale snippets.

 Lists canonical docs paths and summaries
 Prioritizes quickstarts, guides, and API references
 Gives agents a stable starting point for answers

Every DocsAlot project gets a hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.docsalot.dev/yourco. Instead of asking your team to wire infrastructure, the MCP server reads from the same maintained docs you publish for humans.

 search\_docs for retrieval
 get\_page for exact source text
 run\_example for guided examples and snippets [...] /quickstart

Developer

### API Reference

OpenAPI, auth, SDK notes, runnable snippets, and examples packaged into docs developers can trust on first read.

/api/authentication

Agent Map

### llms.txt

A compact routing file that tells ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other agents where your canonical docs live.

/llms.txt

Agent Skill

### skill.md

A packaged operating guide agents can load with tasks, examples, product rules, and the right context for your SaaS.

/skill.md

Tooling

### Hosted MCP

Search, page fetch, and runnable example tools exposed without your team wiring infra or maintaining another service.

mcp.docsalot.dev/acme

Proof

### AI Visibility Audit

See which docs agents can cite, where answers drift, and what to fix next before onboarding quality slips.
